items.title: Elastic Stack 9.5.6 released
items.summary: Version 9.5.6 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 9.5.6 over the previous versions 9.5.5For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.These releases contain security fixes. For details, refer to the Elastic Security Advisories at https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31.
items.creator: Vincent Deuschle
